design.question: Do the sky signs gather at the ends of texts - Spec 050's question in re-scoped form, measured on the graded ICIT corpus, the celestial class fixed by Spec 069's frozen Asset A classification
design.celestial_class: Exactly the signs whose Asset A row carries depicted_kind = sky_cycle (section 4.1); the class is not widened to any jurisdiction-coded subset, to any sign whose label a reader might call celestial while its kind is object_goods, human or other, or to any worker's judgement; contested signs are excluded from the primary and enter only in S2 under their CISI-governed labels; unidentified signs are never celestial
design.frame: The ending population is Shakti's own terminal-strong set: the signs classed TERMINAL_STRONG by the section 2 battery over the primary population (documented-lineage rows only), enumerated in full in Wells space and published at gate 0.4 before any test
design.criteria: Spec 050's criteria carried unchanged (DD-071-5): enrichment ratio R_sky / R_cmp at least 1.5; Fisher's exact test, two-sided, at the 5 percent level; and the half-of-occurrences condition - at least half the celestial class's total occurrences come from member signs individually above the corpus-wide final-position rate. TOO THIN floor (DD-050-3): below 30 total occurrences for the celestial class or the comparison class at gate 0.4 closes TOO THIN, recorded as INCONCLUSIVE's thin form
design.comparison_class: The frequency-matched class of section 4.2: non-celestial, non-contested signs in the primary whose total occurrence count lies within the celestial members' minimum-to-maximum band, inclusive; primary rates are pooled occurrence rates
design.keying: DD-071-10: the route Spec 070's freeze fixed, stated in this spec's own record - a Shakti sign's ICIT code is its Wells number, resolved through the pinned canonical sign registry's parpola_1982 rows' wells_ids to exactly one Asset A sign_key; zero or multiple resolutions is unkeyable
design.disposition: DD-071-11 (conservative): an unkeyable sign enumerated at gate 0.4 closes the execution as POPULATION NOT KEYED, the sign named
design.sensitivities: S1 borderline Asset A rows removed; S2 contested rows included under their CISI-governed sky labels; S3 the documented + corroborated population with the battery classes re-derived (P-F1 S4 both-ways reporting)
